title: 第23章 天纵之才的实力第24章 解除封印
content_zh:
天空蔚蓝，几朵云懒绵绵的飘在上面，青山环绕，碧波荡漾，人行天地间，渺如沧海之一粟。
青山之上，无数的建筑云集，有高大巍峨的，也有低矮难见的，中央大山的标志性十根白色石柱，这里就是瀚海门。
“瀚兴业，瀚兴业！
人呢？”
长老说道，“他去洗脸”
瀚俊熙说道，“你身上的衣服呢？”
长老问，“被他弄脏了，穿不了”
瀚俊熙无奈道，其实内心一直在偷笑，到时候你又要挨骂了兴业。
一个脸上还有点黑的人，突然闯进来，“门也不敲，什么也不讲！”
长老生气道，“不好意思，实在不好意思！”
底下的所有弟子，都看着他。
“还不快回去位置上”
长老瞪了他一眼。
同学们都在偷笑起来，是不是喜欢爱搞恶作剧的瀚兴业吗？怎么今天自己被人搞了，看他那个花猫脸的样子，真搞笑。
这里都是一等天赋和二等天赋的弟子班，来上课的长老也是资质最老，教学质量最高的。
瀚兴业，坐回到位置上，他看了看同桌，好你个瀚俊熙，“你等着，到时候你就笑不出来了”
“好啊，我等着，不过先容我笑一笑，你这个样子实在是太逗了，哈哈”
两个人在下面讲悄悄话，今天的课以实战为主，自然会有学生们之间的切磋，到时候我要把你打趴，瀚俊熙！
一个长相文静的女生，在用余光看着旁边面那两个人，他们两个，还是那么吵吵闹闹的，长相文静的女生笑了笑。
一个坐在后排的女生，她长得水灵可爱，年龄只有十三四岁的样子，但她却是一等天赋，要和那两个天天吵吵闹闹的人代表门内一起去异能比武大会，真是想不明白，他们为什么把这种心思放在学习和修炼上？名叫瀚沐芊的小姑娘，一边转着毛笔，一边想道。

长老坐下来讲了十五分钟左右，就立马叫所有的弟子到外面的训练场上，开始训练。
“今天是友谊切磋，我不会用全力的，你放马过来吧，瀚?璇。”
瀚兴业自信道，场下的弟子都一惊，原来那个文静的女孩也是一等天赋！
瀚兴业已经到达二级异能中阶，这超越所有瀚海门年轻一辈，而瀚?璇才一级异能高阶，这完全是跨级的挑战，不一会儿她便败下阵来，这就是绝对实力上的差距吗？她艰难站起来，退下场去。
“瀚俊熙你可以上来了！”
瀚俊熙为二级异能初阶，每个人都认为他不是很努力，但是以他的一等天赋，竟然现在就已经达到了二级异能，真是令人惊叹。
两人拳脚功夫交手数十回合，渐渐的瀚俊熙逐渐败下阵来，“你赢了，你赢了”
瀚俊熙伸手喊停，“呵，真没趣”
瀚新业不屑道，“还有最后一个，瀚沐芊”
“哦，你急什么？”
瀚俊熙刚要下场，就被绊了一腿，还好反应迅速，用手撑住地面，不然就摔了个狗啃屎了。
“还想偷袭我，呵呵”
“唉呀，没成功”
瀚兴业也有些失望。
长老安排的这三个对手，真是太不堪一击，没有压力呀！
一个十三四岁的小姑娘从下面走上来，“嗯？”
content_en:
The sky is blue, with a few clouds floating lazily on it, surrounded by green mountains, and rippling blue waves. People walking between heaven and earth are as small as a drop in the ocean.
On top of the green mountain, countless buildings gather, some are tall and majestic, and some are low and difficult to see. The ten iconic white stone pillars of the central mountain are the Hanhai Gate.
"Hanxingye, Hanxingye!
Where are people? "
The elder said, "He went to wash his face."
Han Junxi said, "Where are your clothes?"
The elder asked, "It's stained by him and can't be worn."
Han Junxi said helplessly, in fact, he has been snickering in his heart. When the time comes, you will be scolded by Xingye again.
A man with a dark face suddenly broke in and said, "Don't knock on the door, don't say anything!"
The elder said angrily, "I'm sorry, I'm really sorry!"
All the disciples below looked at him.
"Why don't you go back to your seat quickly?"
The elder glared at him.
The classmates were all snickering. Do they like Han Xingye, who loves to play pranks? Why did he get fucked by someone today? It’s so funny to see his cat-like face.
This is a class for disciples with first-class talents and second-class talents. The elders who come to class are also the ones with the oldest qualifications and the highest teaching quality.
Han Xingye sat back down and looked at his deskmate, Han Junxi, "Just wait, you won't be able to laugh anymore"
"Okay, I'll wait, but let me smile first, you look so funny, haha."
The two people are whispering below. Today's class is mainly about practical combat. Naturally, there will be discussions between students. When the time comes, I will beat you to the ground, Han Junxi!
A quiet-looking girl looked at the two people next to her with her peripheral vision. They were still noisy. The quiet-looking girl smiled.
There is a girl sitting in the back row. She is pretty and cute. She is only thirteen or fourteen years old, but she is a first-class talent. She wants to go to the Superpower Competition with the two representatives of the sect who are noisy every day. I really don’t understand why they put such thoughts on learning and cultivation? The little girl named Han Muqian thought while spinning her brush.
The elder sat down and talked for about fifteen minutes, and then immediately called all the disciples to the training ground outside to start training.
"Today is a friendship competition. I won't use my full strength. Just come over here, Han Xuan."
Han Xingye said confidently, and the disciples in the audience were shocked. It turned out that the quiet girl was also a first-class talent!
Han Xingye has reached the middle level of the second level superpower, which is beyond all the younger generation of Hanhai sect, while Han Xuan only has the high level of the first level superpower. This is completely a cross-level challenge. She was defeated after a while. Is this the gap in absolute strength? She stood up with difficulty and left the field.
"Han Junxi, you can come up now!"
Han Junxi is at the beginning of the second-level superpower. Everyone thinks that he is not working very hard, but with his first-level talent, he has now reached the second-level superpower. It is really amazing.
The two fought for dozens of rounds with fists and kicks. Gradually, Han Junxi was defeated and said, "You win, you win."
Han Junxi stretched out his hand to stop, "Oh, it's so boring."
Han Xinye said disdainfully, "There is one last one, Han Muqian."
"Oh, what are you in a hurry for?"
Just as Han Junxi was about to leave the field, he tripped. Fortunately, he reacted quickly and supported the ground with his hands, otherwise he would have fallen and been bitten.
"You still want to sneak attack me, haha"
"Oh, it didn't work."
Han Xingye was also a little disappointed.
These three opponents arranged by the elder are really vulnerable and there is no pressure!
A little girl of thirteen or fourteen came up from below, "Huh?"
